body: Thank you! Autocomplete suggested this and I did not appreciate the magic that is `Ref<T>` 🪄

Looking for feedback from someone smarter than me:

I set this to `true` to prevent the operation continuing. When set to false, it will also show a few frames of error callstack with `InvalidCastException` in the Godot mono internals.

Does setting this to `true` have any side-effects?

**Set to true**

> ERROR: modules/mono/glue/runtime_interop.cpp:246 - Cannot access non-[Tool] C# script from the editor. Consider adding the [Tool] attribute to: res://CustomResource.cs

**Set to false**

>ERROR: modules/mono/glue/runtime_interop.cpp:246 - Cannot access non-[Tool] C# script from the editor. Consider adding the [Tool] attribute to: res://CustomResource.cs
